sources.quote: Includes XBOX Wireless and Bluetooth® technology for wireless gaming on console, PC, mobile phones and tablets.
AA batteries for up to 40 hours of battery life

notes: xbox.com's Xbox Wireless Controller page (en-US) publishes no dimensions, no mass and no complete control or port list, so body, mass, controls and ports stay null/[] (uncovered). Sourced: wireless (Xbox Wireless and Bluetooth), AA cells («AA batteries for up to 40 hours of battery life»; the page does not print how many), host «Optimized for XBOX Series X|S» (platform key microsoft-xbox-series-x; it also pairs with Xbox One and PCs). The page also names a «Dedicated share button», a hybrid D-pad and «the 3.5mm stereo headset jack», but not as complete lists. The Computer History Museum and other museums hold no record of this model found; a Microsoft accessory manual or regulatory filing is the next place to look (FCC mirrors refused automated access and were not pursued).
